status_terms.label: ballot_sent
status_terms.plain_language: Your ballot was issued or mailed to you. Delivery timing may vary.

status_terms.label: received
status_terms.plain_language: Your returned ballot has been received by election officials but final processing may still be pending.

status_terms.label: accepted
status_terms.plain_language: Your ballot has completed the required checks and is accepted for counting under applicable law.

status_terms.label: needs_action
status_terms.plain_language: You must follow the official cure or help path before the applicable deadline.

status_terms.label: not_found
status_terms.plain_language: The public status surface could not find a matching record. Contact the election office or use the official alternate path.

freshness_note: Status data refreshes every 30 minutes during active cure windows.
